text:
Alex G.: Quick check — Evelyn C (onsite) final round tomorrow. Panels are staggered across regions so we need a scribe + debrief lead. Two asks: 1) who can scribe for the 11:00 PT panel? 2) rubric clar: do we mark 'NA' for system design if candidate didn't reach it?

Priya M.: I can scribe 11:00 PT. Created the calendar invite and added Evelyn's prep doc: https://calendar.company/ev-c-evelync. Added the scribe template to the invite.

Samir P.: Thanks. Can we add a timezone-friendly buffer? I'm oncall in the afternoon but can swap if someone can cover 1pm PT.

Sam N.: I can cover 10:00–12:00 PT if we need swaps. @Priya M. can you share which rubric version we're using? Last change was a few weeks ago.

Jules R.: Rubric is v1.3 (latest). Quick rule: if candidate doesn't reach system design, mark as 'insufficient evidence' instead of NA so we capture context. Recommendation field is required (Hire/Maybe/No Hire). Snippet: 
```rubric
version: v1.3
weights:
  technical: 60
  behavioral: 40
score_scale: 1-5
note: mark 'insufficient evidence' when section incomplete (do not use NA)
```

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled — debrief window opens 2h after final panel ends. Debrief template will be posted to the thread 30m before.

Priya M.: Noted. @Sam N I'll forward the invite and add the scribe template here: https://docs.company/scribe-template. Please use timestamped bullets.

Sam N.: :thumbsup: Added. One quick clarifying Q — are we applying senior calibration for IC4? Evelyn is IC4.

Alex G.: IC4 — yes use senior adjustment; expect deeper system design signals. If unsure, flag for calibration and we'll pull in one other senior engineer.

Priya M.: All set from ops. @Jules R can you be the debrief lead at 2:00 PM PT? Need one more voice to steer calibration if needed.

Jules R.: Yep, I can run it and pull up the live evals. I'll open the doc and start at 2:00 PT sharp.

Alex G.: Summary: Priya = scribe 11:00 PT (timestamped notes), Sam = backup coverage 10–12 PT, Jules = debrief lead 2:00 PT, rubric v1.3 rule: mark 'insufficient evidence' for incomplete sections, use senior calibration for IC4. Thanks everyone :tada:
